I count roughly 24 almonds on the plate. A single almond weighs about 1.2 g, so the total is around 29 g.

Almonds have about 5.8 kcal per gram, so 29 g comes to roughly 168 kcal.

To sanity-check the count, the plate is about 22 cm across and each almond is about 2.3 cm long. That fits the count: about 16 almonds in the cluster, plus the 3 or so scattered around it, plus a few hidden underneath.

I'll take 28 g as the weight, which gives about 163 kcal.
